name: SmallPict – Next-Gen Image Optimization, Cloud Storage Offload & Global Edge CDN
author: c0redump

sections.description:
🚀 The Complete Media Performance Platform for High-Growth WordPress Sites

Page speed is directly tied to revenue, conversion rates, and SEO visibility. According to Google, over 60% of average web page weight comes from images, making unoptimized media the single biggest contributor to failing Core Web Vitals (Largest Contentful Paint – LCP), sluggish mobile experiences, and ballooning hosting storage costs.

SmallPict is an enterprise-grade, 100% managed Cloud Media Acceleration suite engineered specifically for modern WordPress sites, WooCommerce stores, digital agencies, and high-traffic publishers.

Unlike traditional image optimizer plugins that consume your server’s CPU and memory, SmallPict processes every heavy task in a dedicated, high-speed cloud infrastructure. We unify next-generation compression (WebP & AVIF), automated cloud storage offload (freeing up hosting disk space), and Global Anycast Edge CDN delivery into one seamless, zero-maintenance workflow.

Official Website | Documentation & API | Pricing & Plans

⚡ Why High-Growth Sites & Agencies Choose SmallPict

  • Zero Server Overhead: Image processing, format conversions, and animation transcoding run entirely on high-speed cloud infrastructure. No server CPU spikes, no memory exhaustion, and no hosting slowdowns.
  • Next-Gen Formats (WebP & AVIF): Automatically transcode heavy JPEGs and PNGs to ultra-efficient WebP and cutting-edge AVIF formats, achieving up to 85-90% file size reduction while preserving crisp visual quality.
  • Hosting Disk Space Liberation: Running low on expensive server storage? SmallPict safely offloads your media library (originals and thumbnails) to cloud storage and frees up valuable server disk space.
  • Zero-Configuration Global Edge CDN: Deliver your media worldwide through a high-performance Anycast Edge Network with HTTP/3, Brotli, and smart edge caching for sub-second load times globally.
  • Multi-Format Animation Transcoding: Heavy GIFs slow down websites. SmallPict automatically converts animated GIFs and other animated sequences into ultra-lightweight animated WebP files with dramatic weight savings.
  • Frictionless Onboarding: Connect your website in seconds using simple, secure email verification. No complex third-party configurations or manual API setup needed.
  • Rock-Solid Safety: Built with strict fail-safe mechanisms so your local files remain completely safe and uploads are never disrupted.

💼 Key Performance Pillars

1. Intelligent Cloud Compression (WebP & AVIF)

SmallPict delivers maximum file size reduction while preserving visual fidelity. Choose between high-efficiency Lossy compression for maximum speed or pixel-perfect Lossless mode for photography and high-end portfolios. Compatible browsers automatically receive modern WebP or AVIF formats with automatic fallback for older browsers.

2. Cloud Storage Offload & Server Disk Recovery

Media libraries can quickly expand to tens of gigabytes, overwhelming hosting backups and triggering costly storage upgrades. SmallPict offloads your media assets into secure cloud storage and reclaims your local disk space, while ensuring your WordPress Media Library, cropping tools, and thumbnails continue functioning smoothly.

3. Global Anycast Edge CDN

Every millisecond counts. SmallPict serves offloaded assets from a global edge network spanning hundreds of worldwide locations, bringing media closer to your visitors for lightning-fast First Contentful Paint (FCP) and smooth browsing experiences.

4. Animation Optimization

Animated GIFs are often tens of megabytes in size. SmallPict automatically detects and optimizes animated media into modern, lightweight animated WebP, delivering silky-smooth motion at a fraction of the bandwidth.

5. Measurable SEO & Core Web Vitals Impact

By drastically reducing page payload and serving assets from edge locations, SmallPict helps your site improve its Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), unlocking higher Google PageSpeed scores and better search rankings.

📊 Feature Matrix & Plan Tiers

SmallPict is designed to scale with your business — from personal blogs to multi-site digital agencies.

  • Free ($0 / mo):

    • 1 Connected Website
    • 20 MB / month raw processing quota
    • WebP static format support (Lossy mode)
    • Up to 2 MB max file size
    • Automatic graceful bypass for animation uploads
    • Standard processing queue

  • Starter ($7 / mo | Rp 19.000 / mo):

    • Unlimited Connected Websites (Shared Quota)
    • 500 MB / month raw processing quota
    • WebP, JPEG, and AVIF conversion
    • Up to 10 MB max file size
    • Animated WebP transcode (up to 5 MB / 80 frames)
    • Dedicated cloud processing queue

  • Pro ($19 / mo | Rp 79.000 / mo) — Most Popular:

    • Unlimited Connected Websites (Shared Quota)
    • 1.0 GB / month raw processing quota
    • Advanced AVIF, WebP, PNG, and JPEG support
    • Lossy & Lossless compression modes
    • Up to 20 MB max file size
    • Target File Size & custom resizing controls
    • Animated WebP/AVIF transcode (up to 12 MB / 180 frames)
    • 50 GB / month Managed Global Edge CDN
    • 10 GB Cloud Storage & Local Disk Space Liberation
    • Priority processing queue

  • Business ($39 / mo | Rp 149.000 / mo) — Enterprise Ready:

    • Unlimited Connected Websites (Shared Quota)
    • 1.5 GB / month raw processing quota
    • Complete next-gen format support (AVIF, WebP, PNG, JPEG)
    • Up to 45 MB max file size
    • Animated WebP/AVIF transcode (up to 25 MB / 350+ frames)
    • 200 GB / month Managed Global Edge CDN
    • 20 GB Cloud Storage & Local Disk Space Liberation
    • Ultra-priority cloud processing queue

🔒 Privacy & Security

  • Secure Cloud Processing: Media files are transferred over encrypted connections and processed in secure cloud infrastructure. In standard mode, files are returned immediately to your WordPress site and wiped from processing memory.
  • Protected Storage: For users utilizing Cloud Storage Offload, assets are stored in isolated, encrypted cloud storage environments.
  • No Content Monetization: We never track, inspect, sell, or monetize your media content.

External services

SmallPict connects securely to the SmallPict Cloud Platform to perform cloud-based image processing, account quota management, and global edge delivery.

  • API Endpoints: https://api.smallpict.app/v1 (Service communication, authentication, and job processing)
  • CDN Endpoint: https://cdn.smallpict.app (Global Anycast Edge CDN delivery for offloaded media assets)
  • Data Transmission: Media files and configuration preferences are securely transmitted over TLS-encrypted connections.
  • Storage & Retention: Standard optimized images are processed in volatile memory and returned immediately. Offloaded media assets are stored securely in cloud storage.
  • Terms of Service: https://smallpict.app/en/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://smallpict.app/en/privacy
sections.installation:
Method 1: WordPress Admin Search (Recommended)

  1. In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for SmallPict in the search box.
  3. Click Install Now, then click Activate.
  4. Enter your email on the setup screen to receive a secure verification code.
  5. Enter the code to connect your site and start optimizing immediately.

Method 2: Manual Zip Upload

  1. Download the latest smallpict.zip package from SmallPict.app or WordPress.org.
  2. In your WordPress admin dashboard, navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and follow the quick setup screen.

Method 3: WP-CLI

  1. Run wp plugin install smallpict --activate
  2. Navigate to Settings > SmallPict in your WordPress dashboard to connect your workspace.
sections.faq:
How does SmallPict protect my web server from high load?

Traditional plugins process images on your hosting server, consuming CPU and RAM that should be reserved for your visitors. SmallPict handles conversions on high-speed cloud infrastructure, keeping your server fast and responsive.

How does Cloud Storage Offload free my server disk space?

SmallPict securely stores your media assets in high-performance cloud storage and safely frees up local upload space on your hosting server once cloud storage is confirmed. This keeps your server lean and avoids expensive hosting storage upgrades.

What prevents broken images if a cloud transfer fails?

SmallPict includes built-in safety controls. If an upload cannot be fully completed, the process stops immediately and your local files remain completely intact, eliminating the risk of missing images or broken links.

Do I need a third-party cloud storage account or custom DNS records?

No. SmallPict provides a fully managed service. You do not need to register separate cloud accounts, manage access credentials, or configure custom DNS records. Cloud storage and global edge delivery work out of the box with 1 click.

How are animated images handled on the Free plan?

On the Free plan, animated images are safely preserved in their original format in your Media Library without errors or interrupted uploads.

Can I use one subscription across multiple WordPress sites?

Yes! Starter, Pro, and Business plans feature Unlimited Connected Websites with Shared Quota Pooling, allowing you to connect client websites or a network of sites to one account.

What happens if I reach my monthly quota?

If your site reaches its monthly optimization quota, subsequent uploads simply save as standard WordPress media without optimization. All previously optimized images and cloud assets continue serving normally without interruption. Quotas reset automatically at the start of your billing cycle.

Is SmallPict compatible with WooCommerce and page builders?

Yes! SmallPict integrates directly into standard WordPress media handling, making it fully compatible with WooCommerce product galleries, Elementor, Divi, Gutenberg, Bricks, and all custom themes.
